usage: 整齊 is an adjective used to describe something that is neat, orderly, or tidy.
It often refers to physical spaces like rooms, desks, or clothes being clean and well-organized.
整齊 can be used in both formal and informal contexts.
You can use it to give compliments or instructions about cleanliness and order.
It is commonly paired with verbs like 擺 (to put) or 保持 (to maintain) to talk about arranging or keeping things tidy.
